name: Hats Off: /hatsoff test hides the hat for 15 s, then gives it back cleanly

steps.msg: precondition: Glamourer connected, Hats Off not hiding anything
precondition: no cutscene, no NPC interaction
Hats Off should report the hat hidden for the test
the hat should actually disappear (precondition: wearing headgear that is shown)
Hats Off should log that it hid the hat

steps.mark: waiting for the test run to end (15 s + restore delay)

steps.msg: the hat should come back after about 15 s
Hats Off should be idle again
Hats Off should log that it restored the hat
no hat flicker while hiding or restoring
no warnings or errors from Hats Off
